# HTML Example

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Hello World</title>
    <style>
        body { font-family: sans-serif; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <h1>Hello, World!</h1>
    <p id="intro" class="text">Welcome to my page.</p>
    <script>
        document.getElementById('intro').textContent = 'Updated!';
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
